dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are visible along the dorsal midline. The outer perimeters exhibit sharp, high-contrast gradients transitioning from dark charcoal exterior to light-grey interior. Edge geometry is non-uniform, with the most prominent superior-central annulus displaying a jagged, thicker inferior boundary and a thinner, more diffuse superior edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients. These clusters are most concentrated on the lateral-posterior flank, where they form an amorphous, high-density patch of light-colored pixels that lack a defined geometric perimeter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A fourth keypoint, derived from the centroid of a cranial 'C' shaped structure, extends this geometry into an irregular quadrilateral spatial relationship.
